title: Apply the AB04/i0 pelvis correction in the sign table
summary: The audited-sign table exception UM21-P01-AB04-i0-pelvis (id kept, so the existing UM21-P01 citation still links) changed from action hold to action correct: AB04/i0 pelvis_tilt x -1, decision D-UM21-P01-1 = C, audit_tasks UM21-P01 and UM21-P02, evidence basis and citation from the UM21-P01 audit and verifier. The hook (sign-application/0.4) negates the stored channel before detection, so the detector, guard and publication rule see it as the other 49 recordings store it; the logged multiplier is the net sign on the stored array (correction -1 x dataset sign -1 = +1), and the log records source_correction (id, factor, decision, audit tasks, evidence), sign_vs_corrected_source, corrections_applied, recording_exceptions and a 'correction' review item. Thigh, shank and foot are never flipped: inputs for AB04/i0 are held, and derive_segment_angles recomputes them from the hook's published channels along the rule-B chain (thigh = pelvis + hip, shank = thigh - knee, foot = shank + ankle). Obliquity (flipped) and rotation (+180 deg) are listed as not released for AB04/i0. The correction is active only when every audit task is done and cites the id and the backlog decision carries answer C; otherwise it holds everything it touches (fail-safe). With the backlog as it stands (UM21-P02 not done) the committed table therefore still holds AB04/i0 pelvis, thigh, shank and foot.

derived_channels.who_computes_them: No adapter calls the hook yet. The current UM21 producers derive segment angles in MATLAB from the stored pelvis before any sign handling: convert_umich_time_to_parquet.m (right/left_thigh_sag = pelvis_sag + hip_flex, shank = thigh - knee, foot = shank + ankle, after choose_pelvis_signal) and convert_umich_phase_to_parquet.m (block 'enforces hip = thigh - pelvis', thigh = pelvis + hip). Both use the source-sign pelvis, so they are wrong for AB04/i0 (and use the pre-rule-B recipe for all recordings).
derived_channels.rule: When UM21 is wired to the hook (CORE-11-P-UM21), segment angles are computed after the hook with derive_segment_angles from the published pelvis, hip, knee and ankle, and pelvis sagittal and thigh/shank/foot velocities with derive_angular_velocities from those angles (or left out for AB04/i0). The hook holds segment-angle and velocity inputs for AB04/i0, holds velocity inputs for every recording, and derive_segment_angles never reads passed-in segment angles.
derived_channels.recipe_equivalence: Rule B pelvis = -1 x corrected source pelvis, so thigh = hip - pelvis_source, shank = hip - pelvis_source - knee, foot = hip - pelvis_source - knee + ankle: the UM21-C03 per_channel recipes.
derived_channels.velocities_in_converters: Time converter: pelvis_sag_vel = gradient(pelvis_sag, dt) and thigh/shank/foot velocities from the stored-pelvis segments. Phase converter: thigh/shank/foot velocities = gradient(angle) * effective_Hz from stored-pelvis segments. For AB04/i0: pelvis sagittal and frontal velocities have the wrong sign, transverse can spike at the wrap, segment velocities carry 2 x d(tilt)/dt.

status_note: Round 2: verifier F1 fixed (velocities); F2 recorded as a CORE-11-P-UM21 condition. Ready for re-verification.

F1: audited_signs.json AB04/i0 exception: derived_velocities = pelvis_tilt, thigh, shank, foot velocity (required by the hook to name the velocity of every corrected and derived channel); velocity_rule names pelvis_sagittal_velocity_rad_s and thigh/shank/foot_sagittal_velocity_{ipsi,contra}_rad_s: recompute after the hook with derive_angular_velocities from the published pelvis tilt and the derive_segment_angles outputs, or leave out; not_released adds pelvis_obliquity_velocity (pelvis_frontal_velocity_rad_s, wrong sign) and pelvis_rotation_velocity (pelvis_transverse_velocity_rad_s, can spike at the +/-180 deg wrap).

sign_application.py: velocity inputs named in derived_velocities and not-released channels are held for that recording (active or not) and never given to the detector; any <angle>_velocity input is held for every recording (velocities are never sign-applied).

sign_application.derive_angular_velocities(angles, spacing_s) with VELOCITY_METHOD: per unit numpy.gradient(edge_order=1), i.e. MATLAB gradient as in the UM21 converters (time: h = 1/sampling_rate_hz; phase: gradient(x) * (150-1)/stride_duration_s, i.e. h = stride_duration_s/149 per stride; equal up to rounding).

Tests: velocity inputs held, not flipped, not detected (also on a normal recording); recomputed velocities equal a hand-written central difference of the rule-B chain and a normally stored recording bit for bit; converter-recipe contrast differs by -2 x d(tilt)/dt; method on a ramp, a quadratic and per-stride spacing; bad spacing and float32 refused; malformed derived_velocities refused; inactive correction holds the velocity; the committed table names the velocities.
round2_fixes.F2_condition_for_CORE-11-P-UM21: No UM21 full run until the adapter derives segment angles (derive_segment_angles) and the pelvis and segment velocities (derive_angular_velocities) after the hook, or the MATLAB converters (convert_umich_time_to_parquet.m, convert_umich_phase_to_parquet.m) are fixed to build them from rule-B angles after the correction. The hook holds AB04/i0 velocity inputs, but velocities written directly by the converters bypass it. Record this in the acceptance criteria of CORE-11-P-UM21 when it is created.
